messages:
Anya: Quick proposal: introduce an "ownership baton" for incidents + a "fast-lane" for high-impact followups. Short pilot?
Raj: Explain baton? sounds useful to prevent drift during rotations.
Anya: IC posts a single-line baton note at handoff: 'BATON -> @next_ic | active_actions: 3 | blockers: none'. Bot parses it and records handoff_ts. If next_ic doesn't ack in 10m, escalate.
Kim: Fast-lane = actions flagged P0/P1 OR recurrence=true. Those get weekly triage and a dedicated reviewer. Keeps important items from languishing.
Sam: Automation: incident-bot will create a fast-lane JQL: `project = PM AND (priority in (P0,P1) OR recurrence = true) AND status != Done`. Weekly digest to #eng-oncall.
Anya: Policy idea: fast-lane actions must have remediation_owner within 24h or auto-assign to oncall lead. Normal actions have 72h claim window.
Raj: Metrics to track in pilot: baton_ack_latency, fastlane_throughput (actions_closed/week), percent_auto_assigned. Two-week pilot to validate.
Kim: I'll manage the fast-lane reviewer rota for the pilot. Small 1-2 person rota each week.
Sam: I'll add parser + JQL digest. Also add a one-line "verify statement" required to close.
incident-bot: Note: scheduler created for fast-lane digest and baton-ack alerts.
Anya: Start next Monday. Goal: reduce ownership drift and cut time-to-critical-fix by 50%. Closing thread; will post template and rota link when ready.
